name: Conrad Maldives Rangali Island
positioning: Island resort spread across two natural islands in the South Ari Atoll, with overwater and beach villas, an undersea restaurant and an undersea residence
best_for: Ocean lovers who want snorkeling and diving with whale sharks and manta rays
Families wanting multi-bedroom beach villas and suites

facts.text: The resort is set across two naturally formed islands in the South Ari Atoll.
The Muraka has a master bedroom submerged beneath the sea.
The Deluxe Water Villa with Pool has a private infinity pool, a lagoon-view deck and direct ocean access.
The Deluxe Beach Villa with Pool has a private plunge pool and an open-air shower.
The Family Beach Villa is two interconnected villas with direct beach access, built for families.
The 2 Bedroom Rangali Ocean Pavilion with Pool has private sandbank access.
The 3 Bedroom Beach Suite with Pool has two master bedrooms and a stand-alone twin bedroom villa within its compound.
The Wine Cellar is two meters underground, a first for the Maldives.
Guests can join the resort's marine biologists to adopt a coral in a coral restoration experience.
A snorkeling experience offers encounters with nurse sharks in shallow waters.
A lagoon tour by boat weaves between the resort's two islands.
The resort's sustainability work includes coral regeneration, solar power and community-led farming.

highlights.text: The Muraka, described as the world's first undersea residence, is a two-level residence whose underwater suite has a 180-degree acrylic dome.
The resort is home to Ithaa, described as the world's first underwater restaurant, five meters below the Indian Ocean's surface.
Whale sharks and manta rays can be encountered year-round in the surrounding waters.
The resort has two distinct spas offering indigenous Maldivian rituals.
The resort has a PADI Eco Center focused on reef education and active coral restoration.

considerations.text: The manta snorkeling trip goes to a site about an hour away from the resort.
In the 2 Bedroom Grand Water Villa, parents with children under 12 are asked to sign a disclaimer on arrival.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires a seaplane transfer.
